# Results: Qwen3.8-27B on MR Gym by reinforcement learning, first runs

Files copied 2026-11-25T21:48:02Z. Some runs were still training then; their tables stop where the copied log stops.

**Status: exploratory.** These runs came before the plan of [PREREG-27b.md](PREREG-27b.md) could be followed as written; the deviations are listed in section 7. One training run with one sampler seed carries the main result, the secret split was read twice with its weights (both readings are below), and a cell holds 48 secret instances. Read it as the first evidence that the model learns on the environment, not as the pre-registered result.

The model is trained by reinforcement learning only: LoRA (rank 32) with GRPO in verl on episodes played through the environment's tools, reward 1 when the delivered result passes the verifier and 0 otherwise. No demonstrations, no supervised step, no reference answers. Thinking is off and a reply holds at most 2,048 tokens, because an episode has to fit one accelerator as a single token stream (section 6).

## 2. The secret split: trained against base on the same instances

Run `v07` trained on NoWrap-v1 levels 1 and 2 only. Its weights after 40 and after 60 steps were evaluated against the base model on the secret split `test-iid`: 48 instances per cell, 2 episodes each, the same instances for both, the trainer's harness, an episode limit of about 57,000 tokens (runs `v12`, `v15`; the base half is shared). NoWrap-v1 level 3 and NullTissue-v0 were never trained on.

What the tables show, and what they do not:

- The trained level gains on instances the model never saw, and the gain is larger after 60 steps than after 40.
- Level 2 gains as well. It was a training cell, but it gave almost no passing rollout before step 30 (section 4): the signal there appeared after level 1 had been learned.
- NullTissue-v0 level 0, another task family, gains without having been trained on. That level is the family's practice level: its text states the method. What carried over is executing a stated method through the tools; the outcome table shows fewer wrong deliveries and fewer episodes ended by rejected calls. No conversation of these episodes has been read yet, so the mechanism is not established.
- Level 3 is at the edge of its interval and is not claimed.
- By the rule of the pre-registration this is "improved on one environment": one trained environment, two were required.

- With thinking off the model passes where the task text gives the method (NoWrap-v1 levels 0-1, NullTissue-v0 level 0) and almost nowhere else; with reasoning on it passes several of the unhinted cells. The tasks are within its reach; the setting that can be trained is the weak one.
- The corrections moved the cells that the calculator had been blocking, and did not move the unhinted levels: there the gap is the method.
- ArtefactClinic-v0 in `c01` and `c04` was served from a build that was not thread-safe (section 6); those two columns are not valid for that family.

## 6. What reading the conversations found

Four reads of about 250 stored conversations of `c04` against the verifiers: [NoWrap levels 2-3](27b/reads/nowrap_l2_l3.md), [PhantomQA](27b/reads/phantomqa.md), [NullTissue, T1Transmit, BandFree, ProtocolToSpec](27b/reads/fitting_families.md), [SNRSpec, FatSuppress, ArtefactClinic](27b/reads/snrspec_fatsuppress_clinic.md). They were written against the code before the corrections; paths in them are relative to the run folders.

- No scoring defect was found in any verifier (near misses recomputed by hand and re-scored).
- Defects of the environment, all corrected before `c05`: the calculator stopped legitimate fitting programs at a step limit, refused to print a non-finite number, and gave list `+` and `*` a meaning other than Python's; the statements never said that the agent's own scans may use any protocol; `plan` printed the image size in the reverse axis order and called a geometry that is never scanned "over budget"; `profile` clipped silently; ArtefactClinic-v0 instances depended on what other threads of the process were building.
- What remains is method: without the hint the model looks at the object with the slow target sequence, probes at the target repetition time, or never measures the transmit field.
- An episode limit that is too small hides learning: on the 33,000-token limit level 2 looked dead in `v07`, on the 57,000-token limit the same weights pass it (sections 2 and 3).

## 7. Deviations from the pre-registration

- Thinking off and 2,048-token replies instead of the planned reasoning setting: with reasoning an episode does not fit one accelerator.
- One trained environment (NoWrap-v1) in the run that carries the result; the plan requires two for "it trained".
- The readout cells of `v07` did not fit the episode limit of its node and its own readout stopped on its length check; the readout was made by separate evaluation-only runs on a larger limit, with the same instances and harness.
- The secret split was read at two checkpoints of the same run (steps 40 and 60); both are reported.
- 48 secret instances per cell instead of the planned number; one sampler seed.
- The evaluation table pools repeated looks at the same weights after a restart; the table the job itself printed kept the newer look only.

## 8. Limits

- One training run; no second seed. `v09` repeats the level-1 gain in direction on other hardware, on the dev split only.
- The transfer to NullTissue-v0 is on its practice level and on the interface before the corrections; on the corrected interface the untrained model already stands higher in the chat harness (section 5), so the size of a training effect there is open.
- All tasks of the suite are measurement tasks by the suite's own open-loop control; nothing here is evidence about decision tasks.
- Six of the nine families give the thinking-off model no passing episode to learn from.

## 9. Reproduce

```
python docs/experiments/27b/report.py --check          # this report from the stored files
python -m mrgym_verl.readout --base <test_base.jsonl> --trained <test_trained.jsonl> --untrained Scanner/NullTissue-v0 --min-envs 2
bash integrations/verl/node/make_main.sh train <settings.env> <job.sh>   # the node script of a run; settings in runs.json
```

The steps with one settings file, what a run costs and the pitfalls: [RECIPE.md](../RECIPE.md).
